old = '''    parts = []
    if start <= PADDING - 1:
        parts.append((start, PADDING - 1))
    if stop >= PADDING + 1:
        parts.append((PADDING + 1, stop))
    return tuple(parts)'''
new = '''    if stop < PADDING or start > PADDING:
        return ((start, stop),)
    parts = []
    if start <= PADDING - 1:
        parts.append((start, PADDING - 1))
    if stop >= PADDING + 1:
        parts.append((PADDING + 1, stop))
    return tuple(parts)'''
assert old in src
open('offline_discovery/rule_remove.py','w').write(src.replace(old, new))
